strategy: Our QQQ opening-move implementation, not a reproduction of QuantLab
instrument: QQQ; consolidated SIP 1-minute trades, regular session
decision: At 09:35 New York, compare completed 09:30-09:34 candle close with EMA12 of completed regular-session 5-minute closes. Long above, short below; equality no trade.
entry: 09:35 minute open, adverse cost; one trade per session. Delay stress uses 09:36 open with original signal.
risk: 0.5% equity planned stop risk, notional capped at 100% equity. Fractional synthetic shares; short availability assumed.
stop: Distance max(2*ATR14 of completed five-minute bars, 0.25% of signal close). Initial stop from entry execution price. Trail using completed minute closes, effective following minute. Adverse gaps fill at open, not stale stop.
exit: Stop or scheduled market exit at session close minus 5 minutes; calendar includes early closes. No overnight positions.

filters.volume: Opening five-minute volume >= median opening volume from previous 20 sessions
filters.timeout: Same entries; exit at 10:05 if latest completed minute close is less than +0.25R from entry
filters.ml_filter: Histogram gradient-boosted return regressor; take only predicted net R >0.05. Retrain yearly on previous 3 calendar years; exclude last 5 training sessions; at least 500 baseline trades. No search. max_iter100, max_leaf_nodes7, min_samples_leaf50, l2_regularization10, learning_rate0.05, random_state42.

costs: Base: 2bp adverse execution per side plus 0.5bp fee per side; short trades charged 2% annualized /252 on entry notional, even intraday. Stress: double execution+fees; separate extra one-minute entry delay. No interest on cash; before tax, FX, subscriptions; fractional and short access unverified.
selection: Report every variant. Select at most one filter/exit on development data: highest CAGR among variants with lower max daily drawdown and at least baseline CAGR; otherwise baseline. Freeze selected name before validation/final evaluation output.
go_no_go: In 2022 onward and final evaluation separately: selected modification must preserve >=90% of baseline gross winning trade dollars, remove >=25% of baseline gross losing trade dollars on fixed-start-capital trade attribution, reduce max daily drawdown by >=20%, retain baseline net CAGR, and beat SPY CAGR by >=3pp without worse drawdown; positive excess over SPY under both stresses. Report failure without retuning.
data_quality: Expected sessions from XNYS calendar. Require all first five minutes and entry bar using information available at entry. Later missing bars never cause a day to be skipped: carry positions across gaps and evaluate stops at next observed open. Require a bar at or after the scheduled exit; fail loudly otherwise. Audit all missing minutes, OHLC, duplicate timestamps, timezone/DST and early closes. Benchmarks retain the full calendar.
limits: Minute bars do not establish tick-level execution or exact intraminute drawdown
Current historical data may be corrected after the fact
Existing knowledge of market history means final window is not pristine prospective evidence
QQQ is a surviving selected ETF; results do not establish CFD/futures performance
No news or LLM retrospective features
No live orders or runtime changes
